verdicts.reason: The paper addresses interference by defining partial-interference estimands and linking them to designs that identify them. Its cluster partition and contact-structure requirements leave the feasibility of joint policies and the incompatibility of individual clone strategies unresolved.

item.problem_title: Emulation assumes no interference, and cloning individuals can produce joint strategies nobody could implement
item.problem_statement: One person's treatment can change another's outcome through infection, provider behavior, household exposure or a shared resource constraint. Target trial emulation as normally practiced invokes no interference, and under that assumption an individual-level protocol is coherent. Identifying a direct or spillover effect requires more than adding the interference literature alongside it: the emulation has to specify a feasible joint or stochastic treatment policy, the exposure mapping or potential-outcome indexing that defines what each unit is exposed to, and joint support for that exposure. Individual clone-censor rules do not identify those effects, because a set of individually compatible strategies need not correspond to any allocation a cluster could receive. item.paper: Emulating Target Trials to Improve Causal Inference From Agent-Based Models.
item.evidence: This is a concrete route out of the no-interference assumption rather than a restatement of it: four estimands under partial interference are named, and each is tied to a randomized design that identifies it, with two-stage randomization identifying the direct, disseminated and total effects with no further confounding argument. What it does not close is the structural precondition. The estimands require a partition into clusters with no cross-cluster connection, and specifying the interference pattern requires the types, frequencies and reasons for contacts or the full contact network, which the same text concedes may not be estimable. Nothing addresses the entry's second clause, that cloning individuals into per-protocol arms can produce joint strategies nobody could implement.
item.quote: To parameterize interference, a model would need to include specification of the types, frequencies, and reasons for contacts between individuals

verdicts.reason: The framework gives target-trial-oriented structure to evaluations of policies and health-system interventions that cannot be individually randomized. It does not establish well-defined policy versions, assignment units, or cluster-level support, so partial addressing is the appropriate effect.

item.problem_title: Emulation is proposed for non-pharmaceutical and policy interventions whose treatment versions and assignment units are not defined
item.problem_statement: Interference, combination therapies, multiple treatment versions and non-pharmaceutical interventions all strain the two-arm, individually assigned, well-defined-intervention assumptions the standard emulation protocol makes. Policy interventions are the sharpest case: delivered to a place or an organization rather than a person, varying in content by implementer, arriving gradually rather than on a date, and often with no comparable version of not receiving them. A policy emulation therefore has to specify the assignment unit, the timing, the comparator, the intervention versions or a stochastic rule over them, the exposure mapping under interference, and a cluster-level estimand. Emulation is being applied to such questions with these filled in by analogy, and when treatment varies only across jurisdictions the causal information comes from the number of independent jurisdictions and t
item.paper: Conceptualising natural and quasi experiments in public health.
item.evidence: A protocol template is supplied for exactly the class of interventions the entry names: policy and health system reforms that cannot be manipulated experimentally. Each of the seven target trial components is given a question set and sensitivity analysis recommendations, and a national minimum wage evaluation is aligned to it. What it does not close is the definition of treatment versions and assignment units. The assignment procedure component is discharged by an argument for as-if randomization rather than by naming who or what is the unit assigned, and a wage increase up to 110 percent of baseline is treated as one strategy without specifying the versions it comprises.
item.quote: Natural or quasi experiments are appealing for public health research because they enable the evaluation of events or interventions that are difficult or impossible to manipulate experimentally, such as many policy and health system reforms.

verdicts.reason: A method-selection guide can reduce arbitrary estimator choice by connecting study features to candidate methods. It does not establish a defensible universal default or require analyses showing how conclusions depend on estimator choice.

item.problem_title: No estimator is defensible as a default, and no study is required to show that its choice mattered
item.problem_statement: The available estimators differ in what they assume rather than only in how they perform. Active-comparator new-user designs with regression or propensity adjustment handle baseline initiation and not treatment-confounder feedback. Matching gives a transparent population, discards information, and often leaves its estimand unstated. Marginal structural models represent regime effects directly and are unstable under extreme weights. The parametric g-formula supports flexible estimands and is sensitive to sequential outcome-model misspecification. G-estimation avoids modeling the treatment-free outcome distribution and is technically demanding. Longitudinal targeted learning is doubly robust, computationally heavy and sensitive to practical positivity. No estimator is defensible as a universal default, and a study reporting one reports a number whose dependence on that choice is unknown: n
item.paper: Developing an Interactive Online Guide to Support the Use of Causal Inference Methods in Comparative Effectiveness Research
item.evidence: The project exists because method choice in registry and health-record studies is unguided, and it supplies a concrete selection route: a user enters study inputs and receives a report naming methods and how to apply them. It does not close the entry. The tool applies to some designs and not others, and nothing in it requires a study to demonstrate that its estimator choice changed the estimate, so a default remains a default with no sensitivity requirement attached.

verdicts.reason: The reporting recommendations improve auditability of phenotype definitions, transformations, and computational settings. They do not require executable analysis code, weight diagnostics, synthetic execution fixtures, or a versioned record of rejected protocols.

item.problem_title: Code, phenotype logic, weight diagnostics and rejected protocol versions are not available for emulations
item.problem_statement: The TARGET statement asks for the target protocol, its data mapping, the estimands, the assumptions, the estimates and the sensitivity analyses, and is a transparency instrument rather than a risk-of-bias certification. An emulation is not externally auditable when its final analysis code, its complete versioned phenotype logic and its weight diagnostics are unavailable, and in current practice they are: most emulations are irreproducible in operative detail despite faithful protocol reporting. Where the real data cannot be shared, code plus a documented schema, a container and synthetic fixtures establishes that the pipeline executes and what it does; it does not reproduce the published estimate, and auditability rather than reproduction is what such a release can deliver. Material protocol amendments belong in a versioned decision log, which nothing currently requires.
item.paper: Transparency in real-world evidence (RWE) studies to build confidence for decision-making: Reporting RWE research in diabetes.
item.evidence: The catalogue makes several artifacts reportable that are normally absent: the source data extraction date and version, the code lists with frequency, temporality, diagnosis position and care setting, the outcome algorithm validation performance, and the software version with macro settings and input parameters, delivered as appendices or via a registered protocol. It does not close the entry. Nothing requires the analysis code itself, the weight diagnostics or the rejected protocol versions to be deposited; the recommendation is to cite a registered protocol, not to publish an executable one.
item.quote: software version and macro or function settings or input parameters should be provided.

verdicts.reason: An audit trail of revisions makes post-registration changes more visible and therefore addresses one part of the transparency gap. It cannot reveal alternatives rejected before registration or document the full sequence of design deliberation.

item.problem_title: Registrations record the final protocol and not the alternatives that were rejected
item.problem_statement: An emulation makes many defensible decisions: active comparator, washout period, time zero, grace period, how treatment episodes are constructed, censoring rules, follow-up length and outcome definition. Each has more than one reasonable answer, and the set of answers is the researcher's degrees of freedom. Design guidance exists and states that the operational methods remain scenario dependent, so it narrows the set without closing it. Registrations record the specification that was finally run and not the alternatives considered, the order in which decisions were made, or which were revised after the data were inspected. A final protocol snapshot cannot reveal what was never logged, so a reader cannot distinguish a protocol written once from one converged upon, and no later audit can reconstruct it.
item.paper: Transparency in real-world evidence (RWE) studies to build confidence for decision-making: Reporting RWE research in diabetes.
item.evidence: Registration is proposed not merely as a deposit of the final plan but with an audit trail of revisions to it, which is the closest thing in this framework to a record of what was changed. It does not close the entry. The three named registries record submitted protocols and their amendments, not the alternative target trials that were considered and rejected before a protocol was submitted, and registration is described as a suggestion rather than a condition of publication.

verdicts.reason: Requiring reporting of validated outcome-algorithm performance makes some phenotype error observable. It neither supplies validation for unvalidated treatment or covariate phenotypes nor identifies a longitudinal measurement-error model that corrects the causal estimate.

item.problem_title: Phenotypes enter emulations as error-free binary variables
item.problem_statement: Prescriptions differ from dispensings and dispensings differ from ingestion; diagnostic codes differ from clinical events; death and care outside the system may be incompletely captured. When a treatment, a time-varying confounder, an eligibility criterion or an outcome is a latent clinical state and the emulation analyzes an error-prone thresholded proxy as though it were fixed, differential longitudinal misclassification distorts several things at once. An erroneous weight factor persists in the cumulative weights of every clone that remains at risk. Artificial-censoring membership changes as well, but only where the mismeasured variable enters the strategy, the eligibility rule or the censoring rule. Without validation information and assumptions that identify a joint measurement model and transport it to the analysis population, measurement bias and confounding bias cannot be uniquel
item.paper: Transparency in real-world evidence (RWE) studies to build confidence for decision-making: Reporting RWE research in diabetes.
item.evidence: Outcome definitions are required to report the performance characteristics of the algorithm where one has been validated, with the worked example stating a positive predictive value of 94% from chart review in diabetics. That makes the error rate visible where it exists. It does not close the entry. Reporting the positive predictive value does not propagate misclassification into the effect estimate, and the requirement is conditional on a prior validation having been done, which leaves unvalidated phenotypes reported as bare code lists.
item.quote: The performance characteristics of outcome algorithm if previously validated.

verdicts.reason: The probability-of-agreement calculation is a graded, variance-aware alternative to a binary replication label. Its no-bias assumption and lack of estimand-alignment assessment mean it cannot diagnose whether disagreement reflects bias, incompatible estimands, or random error.

item.problem_title: Replication is reported as a binary label rather than as a calibrated comparison of estimands
item.problem_statement: Agreement between an emulation and a trial is informative only when the estimands, populations and measurements are close enough to be comparable, and better design alignment is empirically associated with stronger concordance. The benchmarking programs report this in graded form. What is cited downstream is a binary label, usually derived from interval overlap or direction agreement, and that label discards magnitude and uncertainty and cannot diagnose why two estimates differ: two studies estimating the same quantity imprecisely agree by that criterion, and two estimating different quantities precisely disagree. No reported measure, graded or binary, separates estimand mismatch from random error, because doing so requires aligning the estimands first and then reporting a paired contrast with joint uncertainty, which no benchmarking report currently does as a matter of course.
item.paper: Rivaroxaban was found to be noninferior to warfarin in routine clinical care: A retrospective noninferiority cohort replication study.
item.evidence: Rather than declaring replication succeeded or failed, agreement is scored as the probability that the emulation estimate falls inside the trial interval given the variance ratio, benchmarked at 83% when variances are equal: 60% for intention-to-treat, 40% for per-protocol and 67% for as-treated. That converts a binary label into a precision-aware statement. It does not close the entry, because the metric assumes no bias in the emulation estimate and says nothing about whether the two estimands match; the secondary efficacy contrast reversed sign (1.18 against 0.86) and the metric offers no scale for that.
item.quote: The probability of estimate agreement is a function of the ratio between the variance of the estimate in our study to that of the target trial assuming no bias in the former estimate.

verdicts.reason: The harmonization procedure directly improves comparability by making eligibility, strategies, outcome, follow-up, and contrast explicit before comparing estimates. Exploring residual differences one at a time does not provide a calibrated decomposition of remaining mismatch and sampling uncertainty.

item.paper: Effect Estimates in Randomized Trials and Observational Studies: Comparing Apples With Apples.
item.evidence: A three-stage procedure replaces the replication label with a like-for-like comparison: harmonize eligibility, strategies, outcome, follow-up and causal contrast, reanalyze both datasets with the same estimator, then probe each remaining mismatch. It moves the comparison from an uninterpretable difference to a 5-year risk difference of 4.2 against 2.1 percentage points on a shared estimand. It does not close the entry: four unharmonized differences remain, each explored separately, and the residual gap is still not apportioned between them.
item.quote: Then a set of sensitivity analyses were conducted to explore the impact on the nonharmonized components on the effect estimates.
